Rail Wheel Factory RWF Apprentices Online Form 2025 – Full Details

Rail Wheel Factory RWF Apprentices Online Form 2025. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal before the closing date. Review all important dates, application fee requirements, eligibility criteria, and instructions given below. Important: 01 April 2025 is the deadline to submit the online form.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 01 March 2025
  • Application Start Date : 01 March 2025
  • Last Date : 01 April 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 April 2025
  • Merit List / Result : As per Schedule

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • Female All Category : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete registration with your basic details, mobile number, and email.
  3. Fill the application form carefully with educational and personal details.
  4. Upload scanned copies of required documents, photograph, and signature.
  5. Pay the examination fee online and take a printout of the confirmation page.
